entities.name: Cecilia Malmström
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Anna Cecilia Malmström is a Swedish politician who served as European Commissioner for Trade from 2014 to 2019. She previously served as European Commissioner for Home Affairs from 2010 to 2014 and Minister for European Union Affairs from 2006 to 2010. She was a Member of the European Parliament (MEP) from Sweden from 1999 to 2006.

entities.summary: Anna Cecilia Malmström is a Swedish politician who served as European Commissioner for Trade from 2014 to 2019.
